title: Practice 1: Антон Чехов · Анна на шее

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Она ушла, и Аня заняла ее место около ___ (серебряный самовар) с чашками.
exercises.why: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «List of prepositions which are followed by the genitive case: без, вдоль, вместо, для, до, из, из-за, из-под, кроме, мимо, около, от, после, против, с, у.» — DLI, Lesson 60.

exercises.why: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.

exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Он брал ___ (груша), мял ее пальцами и спрашивал нерешительно:
exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.

exercises.q: Петя и Андрюша, худенькие, бледные мальчики с ___ (большие глаза), брали графинчик и говорили растерянно:
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: После венчания не было даже легкой закуски; молодые выпили по бокалу, ___ (переодеться) и поехали на вокзал.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Не ___ (мочь) не припомнить теперь одного обстоятельства, — сказал он, улыбаясь.
exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Я никому не ___ (позволить) надзирать за мной! — кричал он.
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: После венчания не было даже легкой закуски; молодые выпили по бокалу, ___ (переодеть / переодеться) и поехали на вокзал.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Он ___ (встать / лечь / сесть), не спеша снял с шеи орден, снял фрак и жилет и надел халат.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: После венчания не было даже легкой закуски; ___ (молодой) выпили по бокалу, переоделись и поехали на вокзал.
exercises.why: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.

exercises.q: Аня кланялась, и голова у нее в ___ (сам) деле не отваливалась, но было мучительно.
exercises.why: The preposition **в** + prepositional is used to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place: *Я был там в этом месяце. Я был там в январе. Я поеду туда в будущем году.* It is also used to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period: *Он был здесь в начале года. Он был здесь в конце месяца.* The preposition **на** + prep. is used to indicate the week during which an event takes place: *Я поеду туда на этой неделе.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 73.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The preposition **в** + prepositional is used to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place: *Я был там в этом месяце.
